summary: Iteration 5: tested full upfront payment, N/E/W/EC/NW/WC postcodes, the /commercial-cleaning page and walkthrough form (desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844), the walkthrough API (public, plus admin owner-only), the admin Site walkthroughs page, before/after job photos, and the Policies drafts. Backend: 22/22 new pytest tests pass. They cover: payment_mode full_upfront; preview deposit == total; booking payment_transactions.amount == total with kind 'booking' and balance_due 0; 6 London postcodes return 'ok'; walkthrough 422 for past/today dates, an invalid establishment and a bad email; photos get walkthrough_id; tokens and paths are not exposed; admin walkthroughs return 401 for anonymous users and 403 for staff; confirmed needs a date and time; alternative_proposed needs a message; invalid status gives 400; job photos give 401/422/415, the owner can upload before/after, and staff get 404 until assigned and 200 after. Frontend: the hero button reads BOOK A FREE SITE WALKTHROUGH (uppercase). All 10 cards load their images. Pub, office and gym show their own extra fields. Submit stays disabled until the required fields are filled. Photo upload and remove work. The confirmation text matches exactly. There are no prices, no parking questions and no 'Get a Free Quote'. The Commercial nav link works, /services/commercial redirects, and the /quote Commercial link shows. Booking UI: review shows 'Pay £87.00 & confirm' and no deposit; the booking redirected to Stripe; the DB shows total 87, deposit 87 and tx 87 'booking'. The home page and quote summary text are correct. Admin walkthrough sheet: answers, 2 photos, and propose/confirm/complete/decline all change the badge. The booking sheet keeps before/after uploads separate from customer photos. The Privacy draft is unpublished, has a Photographs section and 3 REVIEW markers; the terms draft has 5 markers and the published v1 is unchanged. The core features work. Issues are listed below.

critical.issue: Customers must accept the published Company Policy at the terms step of every online booking. It still says 'A 50% deposit is required to confirm your booking' and 'Non-Refundable Deposit Policy'. This contradicts full upfront payment and the requirement that the booking must not mention a 50% deposit. The draft has REVIEW REQUIRED markers, but until the owner publishes new wording, customers see the deposit wording. Tell the user/owner this is waiting on their approval.

minor.issue: status=confirmed with an invalid confirmed_date (e.g. 'garbage') returns 500, because fmt_date raises an exception. Validate it with date.fromisoformat and return 422. A past confirmed_date is also accepted.

body.message is added to the confirmation email. The admin UI sends the same message textarea for every action, so after 'Propose another time' the confirmation email said: 'confirmed for Wed 28 Oct 2026 at 14:00. TEST_ Could we visit Friday at 2pm instead?'. Clear the message after each action, or use a separate field for the confirmation note.
There are no status transition rules. A walkthrough can be declined after being visited, or confirmed again. Each confirm sends another email.
alt_date is not validated (an invalid string or a past date is accepted). There is no rate limit or captcha on this public endpoint, and it sends owner and customer emails.

During testing all emails returned 429 'email rate limit exceeded' from integrations.emergentagent.com, so communications show status 'failed'. The error reason is not stored on the communication and failed emails are never retried. Store the error and add a retry.

The FAQ 'Can I reschedule or cancel?' still says '...will result in the deposit being forfeited'. The FAQ 'Which areas do you cover?' still says 'focus on South London'. Both are now inconsistent with full payment and the wider London coverage. seed.py SOLID_V3_BUSINESS still contains payment_mode 'deposit_50' (it only runs while extras_v3 is unset, but it is stale).

ui_bugs.issue: nice() replaces '_' with spaces in every value, including free text. Business 'TEST_ UI Office' shows as 'TEST UI Office', and contact name and address are also changed. An email such as john_smith@x.com would show as 'john smith@x.com'. Apply nice() only to enum values (kind, frequency, time, condition).
Premises answers show raw keys ('workstations', 'bar_areas') instead of the form labels ('Number of desks / workstations'). An empty days array still shows an empty 'Days' row.

The cards are <button> elements, which centre their content vertically. In each row of 5, the photos start at different heights (e.g. office starts higher than pub). Add 'flex flex-col justify-start' or 'self-start' so images line up at the top.
The file input value is not reset after upload, so picking the same file again does nothing. One busy flag drives both the before and after spinners.

issues: Preferred date, alternative date and ideal start date use the browser's native date input (shown as mm/dd/yyyy, US format) instead of the shadcn Calendar used on /quote.
Mobile 390px: the round chat button covers the hero 'Fully insured' badge text and part of the confirmation message.
The confirm date uses a native date input (mm/dd/yyyy). The time is a free-text input; use the same time pills or a select.
The Decline button turns teal on hover/focus, which does not match the brand.
Teal accents (selected item, Publish hover) are inconsistent with the green/gold brand. The effective date is a native date input.

action_items: HIGH: Show the user/owner that the published Company Policy (terms v1), which customers must accept at booking, still describes a 50% non-refundable deposit. The owner needs to supply wording and publish the draft; consider a temporary note on the terms step.
Validate confirmed_date (ISO, not in the past) in PATCH /api/admin/walkthroughs. It currently returns 500 for an invalid date.
Stop the 'Propose another time' message from leaking into the confirmation email: clear the message after an action, or use separate fields.
Fix nice() in Walkthroughs.jsx so it does not change business names, contact names, emails or addresses. Show labels instead of raw keys for premises answers.

Optional: status transition guards for walkthroughs, alt_date validation, rate limit on the public walkthrough POST, store the email error and retry failed emails, update the KB FAQs (cancellation deposit, areas), align the commercial cards to the top, use the shadcn calendar instead of native date inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_walkthrough.update_walkthrough: fmt_date(body.confirmed_date) is not validated, so it raises an exception and returns 500.
routes_walkthrough: WalkPatch.status is Optional[str] and is checked by hand against STATUSES; a Literal type would be cleaner. There is no transition validation.
Walkthroughs.jsx Actions: send() spreads the whole form {confirmed_date, confirmed_time, message} for every status, so the message is sent for confirmed/completed/declined.
WalkthroughForm tomorrow() uses toISOString(), which is UTC. Late at night in the UK during BST, 'min' may allow today, and the backend then returns 422 with a toast. This is minor.

routes_public.create_booking still contains the '50% deposit - ' Stripe product name branch and the deposit kind. It is harmless with full_upfront, but it is dead code unless deposit mode is kept on purpose.
photo_file allows the owner to view walkthrough photos (no booking_id), while staff get 404. This is correct, but the route lives under /api/admin/bookings/photos/, which is confusing.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (every requested flow works; label/underscore display bug and a message leaking into the email)

test_credentials: Owner admin@solidcleanltd.com / SolidClean#2026 works. Staff test users are created and deleted inside the pytest run.
seed_data_creation: All data from this run was deleted from Mongo: TEST_ UI Office/TEST_ UI Pub walkthroughs and photos, TEST_ UI Booker booking, tx and photos, pytest bookings, walkthroughs, photos and staff. Leads, quotes and communications for delivered@resend.dev remain (merged lead). The main agent's 'TEST_ Pub' walkthrough (6ad784a80dccef0c3908d2aa) was left in status 'requested'; pytest's edge check briefly changed it and then reverted it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `-n 0`: `pytest backend/tests/test_iter5_fullpay_walkthrough.py -n 0`. It deletes its own data through pymongo (test_database). Use real JPEGs for photo uploads (e.g. made with PIL into /tmp/imgs); hand-written base64 PNGs return 415. The quote calendar day buttons are '[data-testid=quote-calendar] button[name=day]:not([disabled])' and the slots are [data-testid^=quote-slot-]. Admin bookings: pending bookings are under the 'Awaiting payment' tab, and the booking-view-btn-{id} buttons open the sheet. The email provider was returning 429 rate limits during this run.
